structured_output.what_is_happening: BANDS ("Mr Bands") was launched on the Meteora dynamic bonding curve about 2.9 hours before detection, graduated to a Meteora pool about 38 minutes before detection, and was up +55-72% in the last hour on about $86-89k of volume at roughly $114-126k market cap. Buyers outnumber sellers (506 unique buyers vs 210 sellers in the hour). The token is tied to a real, if small, project. Mr Bands is an "autonomous AI market maker" agent providing liquidity on Meteora DLMM. It has a public GitHub repo (Bands-Finance/bands-finance, 336 commits, 0 stars) and a documented real-money run on 17-19 Sep 2026 that earned 7.91 SOL in fees but ended slightly down overall (19.79 to 19.71 SOL). The website mrbands.finance and the X handle @MrBandsSol match the DexScreener profile. I found no indexed X posts, Reddit threads, Telegram groups or news about the token itself.

narrative.description: An AI agent that runs a real Meteora DLMM liquidity bot and 'builds in public'. It fits the recurring AI-agent-with-a-real-product meme category, and the working code and public P&L are a real hook.
narrative.why_spreading: Most likely driven by the project's own X account and its followers, plus DexScreener/GMGN trending after graduation. The AI-agent framing and a public GitHub give traders a reason to buy. I could not see any X posts, so I cannot confirm organic spread.

token_connection.why_this_token: This is the only BANDS pair with liquidity and volume. Its DexScreener and GeckoTerminal profiles link to mrbands.finance and @MrBandsSol, the same handle the GitHub README cites. It launched through Meteora DBC, and the Streamflow vesting locks (about 15.7% of supply) are consistent with an intentional project launch.
token_connection.competing_tokens: There are about 10 other BANDS / 'Mr Bands' copies on pump.fun and elsewhere, all dead (about $3-4k market cap, zero liquidity). GMGN counts 24 tokens linked to the dev X account, most likely these copycats attaching the handle.

authenticity.evidence: Real code and product on GitHub, and a website that matches. The buyer count is high relative to sellers. On the other side, GMGN flags 40 bundler wallets, 86 fresh wallets and a 61% bot/degen rate. The community-takeover flag is set and the creator closed out their position (creator balance 0). No paid DexScreener boosts.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not read X (HTTP 402), so I don't know the account's follower count or whether KOLs are posting it. The bundler share could mean the launch was coordinated.

structural_risks: 40 bundler wallets and 30% fresh wallets could dump into buyers
Liquidity of about $38k is thin against a $126k market cap, so price moves are volatile in both directions
The Streamflow-locked supply (about 15.7%) could become overhang when it unlocks
Top 10 holders own 21% excluding the lockers; GeckoTerminal shows 49.5% including them

structured_output.counterargument: Coins that pump right after graduation, with 40 bundlers and a 61% bot share, often top out within the first hour of migration. The +72% in the last hour may already be the peak, with bundlers distributing into late buyers. The product's own record is a tiny, slightly losing run, and a GitHub repo with 0 stars suggests almost no developer following. I could not see the X account, so the audience may be very small.
unknowns: Follower count and engagement of the @MrBandsSol X account
Whether KOLs or call channels are pushing it
Who owns the Streamflow-locked supply and when it unlocks
How the bundlers are behaving (holding or distributing)

source_coverage.notes: The X profile fetch returned HTTP 402, and web searches for the contract address, $BANDS and the handle found no X posts. I found the GitHub repo and the website. DexScreener live data at about 13:05 UTC showed $126k market cap and +72% over the hour.

structured_output.thesis: This is the canonical token for a real AI liquidity-bot project, with a credible AI-agent story, and it is just past graduation with strong buy-side momentum at about $126k market cap. Doubling to about $250k within 6 hours is plausible, but the bundler and bot share are high, the creator has exited, and I could not see X to confirm organic reach. I rate the runner probability a bit below break-even.
